_comment: r41 Crown Overlook vista (coordinator, 26 Oct). GPU SW8: 'no vista at crown overlook'; r40: the Crown massif reads at 900 m as a flat grey slab. Two flagged pieces, both OFF until judged.
scope: deck: world geometry with colliders on every shell (presentation build only on drawing shells); massif: client presentation, no collision

deck._candidate: A raised timber lookout 15 m along the 37 deg Crown sightline from the Crown Overlook spot (on crown_sightline_loop), clear of the path corridor (route_half_width 7.5 + 1 m), its 7 m ramp running back down to the path. Weathered timber (the Ashfoot storm finish's wood), dark rails on three sides, the Meshy Stormwood lantern post lit on the front corner. The F41 survey stand moves onto the deck with this flag (debug_teleport_spots f41_survey).
deck._why_half_m: r41 by eye: at 6 x 6 m the catalogue camera (5.2 m behind the trainer) hung off the deck edge in the side views and the rails crossed the frame. 12 x 11 m keeps every catalogue camera over the deck.

massif._candidate: Distant-only Hollow Crown silhouette (MESHY stormwood_hollow_crown_silhouette, requested 26 Oct): drawn beyond visible_from_m so play inside the Crown is untouched; no collision.
massif._why_model: tb/meshy-1024 2cbd71381 concept c1_0 (provenance beside the GLB): a ring of jagged spires round a hollow plateau, sheer cliffed sides, conifer ledges, crystal glints. The GLB is 1.9 wide x 1.36 tall: at 560 m wide over a 30 m base the spires top out about 400 m, above the Crown's terrain walls (max 360 m), so the crown reads at 900 m.
